title: Cheesy Rallys Fries
description: A recipe for making crispy fries topped with melted mozzarella and habanero jack cheese.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F (Bake) until fully hot.
Put parchment on a metal baking sheet, trimmed so it doesn’t hang over the edges.
Spread Rally’s fries in a single layer on the parchment.
Switch oven to Air Fry at 450°F and put the pan on the middle rack.
Cook for 8 more minutes (or until as crispy as you like).
Pull the pan out, cover with mozzarella + habanero jack.
Put back in the oven for 1-2 minutes to melt the cheese.
notes:
Ensure the oven is fully preheated for optimal crispiness.
